name: XDKNet 2.4.14
body:
Android TV 2.4.14, alongside XDKNet server plugin 2.0.9.3 (Emby 2.0.4.3).

TVs on 2.4.10 or later offer this update on their own. On 2.4.9, use
Settings > About > Check for updates. Anything older has to install it once
by hand, from the `XDKNet_AndroidTV.apk` below.

## Ratings from MDBList

IMDb, Metacritic, Letterboxd and the other extra ratings come from MDBList,
through the XDKNet server plugin. When they couldn't come through, a title
page only showed the server's own Rotten Tomatoes and community ratings, and
nothing said why.

- **Settings > Metadata & Ratings** now says why under **Additional ratings**
  when MDBList ratings aren't coming through: no MDBList API key on the
  server, the key's daily request limit used up, or MDBList's own reason.
  Nothing extra shows when they work.
- **Plugin 2.0.9.3:** when an MDBList key ran out of requests, MDBList's
  refusal was saved as "this title has no ratings" and kept for a week. It is
  now treated as a failed lookup and tried again later, titles already caught
  by it recover within a day, and lookups pause for a while once a key's limit
  is reached instead of spending more requests. The "Clear MDBList cache"
  button on the plugin page brings everything back at once.

Pair with plugin 2.0.9.3.
